name: Weather Lookup
description: Look up the weather forecast for a city. Calls the public Open-Meteo forecast endpoint at https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast and returns temperature, wind speed and precipitation for the next seven days.

tools.name: get_forecast
tools.description: Return the seven-day forecast for one city. Takes a city name, queries the declared Open-Meteo endpoint and returns JSON. It reads no local files and stores nothing.

tools.name: list_supported_units
tools.description: Return the list of unit systems the forecast tool understands: metric, imperial. Takes no arguments and performs no requests.
